name: tdld
description: yt-dlp on a timer: polls three link lists (audio only, channels, playlists) and downloads new videos with yt-dlp and ffmpeg. A small web UI edits the lists, starts single downloads and shows the logs. A hotfolder converts dropped video files to mp3. For YouTube, put exported browser cookies into /config/ytdlpconfig/cookies.txt (see the project README).

paths.name: Config
paths.description: Lists, yt-dlp configs, cookies.txt, download archives, logs and the download script

paths.name: Downloads
paths.description: Downloaded media, in audioonly/, channels/ and playlists/

paths.name: Hotfolder
paths.description: Optional: video files dropped into input/ are converted to mp3 in output/

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Web UI for the download lists and logs. No login: don't expose it to the internet.

variables.name: UMASK
variables.description: 002: new files are writable for the users group, e.g. over SMB

variables.name: AUTO_UPDATE_YTDLP
variables.description: true: update yt-dlp once at every container start instead of waiting for a new image

variables.name: TDLD_ALLOWED_HOSTS
variables.description: Host names the web UI answers to besides IP addresses, single words (tower) and *.local, e.g. a reverse proxy name; comma-separated
